purpose: Append-only repair of every executor ambiguity found in v1. This package may hash bound sources and exercise synthetic rows only; it may not decode a CF4, VAST, Pantheon+, validation, or confirmation scientific value.

v1_blocker_dispositions.blocker: STF shear basis and normalization were unspecified
v1_blocker_dispositions.repair: freeze the five Frobenius-orthonormal matrices and coefficient order in stf_shear

v1_blocker_dispositions.blocker: velocity nuisance terms were not explicitly mapped into ln(1+z)
v1_blocker_dispositions.repair: divide the complete nuisance velocity and delta_H*L_void by c_km_s exactly once

v1_blocker_dispositions.blocker: equal-count distance strata and distance ties were ambiguous
v1_blocker_dispositions.repair: sort by the exact tuple (Dist_Mpc, canonical_1PGC_integer), assign floor(10*rank/N)

v1_blocker_dispositions.blocker: permutation statistic, tail, and finite-sample correction were unspecified
v1_blocker_dispositions.repair: freeze the positive-delta_H profile-delta-chi-square statistic, inclusive right tail, and Phipson-Smyth plus-one correction

v1_blocker_dispositions.blocker: profile solver and numerical ties were unspecified
v1_blocker_dispositions.repair: freeze a nine-parameter ridge normal system, explicit Cholesky algorithm, canonical summation order, grid, and tie tolerance

v1_blocker_dispositions.blocker: validation and confirmation primary minima could not be known while their rows stayed sealed
v1_blocker_dispositions.repair: freeze raw-ID minima at IDS_PARTITIONED and defer eligible-primary minima to each separately authorized role opening
freeze table-specific keys and reject semantics without tolerance-based deduplication
freeze byte-level ASCII I, F, A, missing, signed, decimal, exponent, line-ending, and finite-value grammar

v1_blocker_dispositions.blocker: relative paths and stage barriers were not enforced canonically
v1_blocker_dispositions.repair: resolve normalized repository-relative POSIX paths under one physical repository root and expose no real-row parser or scoring command
v1_blocker_dispositions.remaining_gate: a separate auditor must bind this mutation-freeze receipt before IDS_PARTITIONED

canonical_paths.path_grammar: nonempty normalized POSIX relative path; no backslash, drive, root, empty component, dot component, or dot-dot component
canonical_paths.containment: resolved target must be a regular non-symlink file strictly below the resolved repository root; every existing parent from root through target must be non-symlink
canonical_paths.hash_rule: stream raw bytes in 1048576-byte chunks through SHA-256; do not decompress or parse during build/check/status

strict_record_grammar.record_framing: remove exactly one terminal LF and, only when immediately before that LF, one CR; reject embedded CR/LF, bare terminal CR, additional terminal newlines, and post-removal length mismatch
strict_record_grammar.space: only ASCII 0x20 is whitespace inside fixed-width fields; tabs and every other control byte reject
strict_record_grammar.missing: a field containing only ASCII spaces is missing; a required missing field rejects; missing never maps to zero
strict_record_grammar.I: full field must match ASCII regex space-star sign-optional digit-plus space-star; sign is plus or minus; no decimal point, exponent, tab, or internal space
strict_record_grammar.F: full field must match ASCII regex space-star sign-optional (digits-plus dot digits-star OR dot digits-plus) space-star; a decimal point is mandatory; exponent, NaN, Inf, comma, and implied-decimal integer forms reject; parsed binary64 must be finite
strict_record_grammar.A: bytes must be printable ASCII 0x20 through 0x7e; decode ASCII and remove trailing ASCII spaces only
strict_record_grammar.identifier_canonicalization: parse 1PGC by I grammar, require integer >0, then hash the base-10 str(integer) ASCII with no sign, spaces, or leading zeroes
strict_record_grammar.line_and_field_failures: any failure aborts the stage; rows are never silently dropped

stf_shear.normalization: each basis matrix is symmetric, trace zero, and Frobenius-orthonormal: trace(E_a^T E_b)=Kronecker_delta_ab
stf_shear.direction_rule: construct n from CF4 RAdeg/DEdeg using geometry-v3 and renormalize once by its Euclidean binary64 norm; reject zero or nonfinite norm

likelihood.baseline: s_FLRW=log1p(z_D), where z_D is the geometry-v3 Planck2018 inversion of CF4 Dist luminosity Mpc
likelihood.distance_check: DMzp and Dist must pass geometry-v3 dual-rounding identity
likelihood.law_column: z_void=L_void_Mpc/c_km_s; coefficient delta_H has km/s/Mpc; delta_H*z_void is dimensionless
likelihood.nuisance_velocity_design: v_nuisance=a_D*D_path_comoving_Mpc+B_x*n_x+B_y*n_y+B_z*n_z+D_path_comoving_Mpc*sum_a(S_a*n^T E_a n); this distance is distinct from the catalog luminosity Dist used for stratification and uncertainty
likelihood.velocity_to_log_mapping: X_log=X_velocity/c_km_s and prediction_log=(v_nuisance+delta_H*L_void_Mpc)/c_km_s; divide by c_km_s exactly once after forming each velocity-design column
likelihood.same_design: the identical nine columns, priors, rows, weights, and solver are used for null and alternative

profile_solver.binary_format: IEEE-754 binary64 only; nonfinite intermediate aborts
profile_solver.row_order: ascending canonical 1PGC integer before every sum and solve
profile_solver.sum_rule: each scalar dot product is math.fsum over that row order; no parallel or BLAS reduction is part of the reference solver
profile_solver.factorization: lower Cholesky in coefficient indices 0..8: L[j,k]=(A[j,k]-fsum_m<k L[j,m]L[k,m])/L[k,k] for j>k and L[k,k]=sqrt(A[k,k]-fsum_m<k L[k,m]^2); nonpositive diagonal aborts
profile_solver.solve: forward substitution then backward substitution, both coefficient-index ascending/descending with math.fsum
profile_solver.profile_value: evaluate the original objective at beta_hat using math.fsum in canonical row order, not a subtracted normal-equation shortcut
profile_solver.tie_tolerance: tau(a,b)=8*2^-52*max(1,abs(a),abs(b)); candidates whose chi2 differs from the raw minimum by <=tau(candidate,raw_min) are tied
profile_solver.tie_choice: among tied grid candidates choose lexicographic minimum (abs(delta_H),delta_H), preferring zero, then the negative value at equal magnitude
profile_solver.delta_chi2: chi2_profile(0)-chi2_profile(best); clamp to zero only when negative by no more than tau; otherwise abort

distance_strata.sort_key: exact parsed binary64 CF4 luminosity Dist_Mpc ascending, then canonical 1PGC integer ascending; never substitute D_path_comoving_Mpc
distance_strata.ties: equal Dist_Mpc values are never split nondeterministically; 1PGC supplies the total-order tie break
distance_strata.assignment: for zero-based rank r among N rows, stratum=floor(10*r/N); require N>=10
distance_strata.size_invariant: all strata are nonempty and maximum size minus minimum size is at most one

permutation_test.fixed: y, sigma_s, Dist_Mpc, directions, nuisance design, priors, strata, row order, and delta_H grid
permutation_test.rng: NumPy 2.2.6 Generator(PCG64(902104729)); one generator is constructed once; for permutation index 0..9999 and stratum 0..9 call generator.permutation(m_s) once and assign the stratum values in ascending canonical-row-index order
permutation_test.statistic: T=max(0,chi2_profile(0)-chi2_profile(best)) when selected best delta_H>0; T=0 when selected best delta_H<=0
permutation_test.tail: inclusive right tail: count permutation T_b >= observed T using exact finite binary64 comparison, so exact equality is a tail event
permutation_test.invalid: any nonfinite statistic or solver failure aborts the entire test; no permutation is replaced

duplicate_semantics.CF4_TABLE4: 1PGC is the unique key across all 38053 records; any repeated canonical integer rejects the entire source, even if bytes are identical or roles would match
duplicate_semantics.VAST_TABLE1: among all exact Cosmo='Planck2018' rows before edge filtering, (Cosmo,void) is unique; any repeat rejects, even if edge differs or bytes are identical
duplicate_semantics.VAST_TABLE2: multiple spheres per (Cosmo,void) are required and allowed; the unique row key is (Cosmo,void,x,y,z,Rad) using Python binary64 equality, so signed zeroes compare equal; a repeated key rejects even if bytes are identical
duplicate_semantics.cross_void_geometry: the same exact (x,y,z,Rad) under different void IDs is retained; ray intervals are unioned so it cannot be double-counted
duplicate_semantics.no_fuzzy_dedupe: no angular, spatial, floating-tolerance, or byte-preference deduplication is permitted
duplicate_semantics.sphere_membership: a Planck2018 VAST_TABLE2 row whose exact (Cosmo,void) has no Planck2018 VAST_TABLE1 key rejects; a sphere matched to edge=1 is counted and excluded; a sphere matched to edge=0 is retained
duplicate_semantics.partial_mask: partial-mask CF4 IDs are retained in a counterexample ledger but never enter the primary likelihood

split_and_access.split: SHA256(canonical positive 1PGC ASCII); bucket is unsigned big-endian digest bytes 0..7 modulo 10; buckets 0..5 development, 6..7 validation, 8..9 confirmation
split_and_access.SOURCE_HASHED: the only stage implemented by v2 build/check/status: canonical-path validation, byte count, and streaming raw SHA-256; no decompression, row framing, field slice, or scientific parse
split_and_access.MUTATION_FREEZE: v2 config, module, test, receipt, predecessor, law, geometry, and raw-source hashes are immutable; this receipt requests, but cannot self-grant, an independent audit
split_and_access.IDS_PARTITIONED: not authorized by v2; after a separate audit-pass receipt, a successor may decompress CF4 and parse only bytes 1..7 by strict I grammar; every other CF4 byte and every VAST/Pantheon+ byte remains semantically opaque
split_and_access.DEVELOPMENT_OPEN: not authorized by v2; requires an append-only release receipt binding the audit pass and ID ledger; only development CF4 rows may be parsed; validation and confirmation retain only raw row hashes and byte offsets; shared VAST/mask geometry may then open
split_and_access.VALIDATION_OPEN: not authorized by v2; requires immutable development predictions, choices, decision, and a new explicit release receipt; confirmation stays opaque
split_and_access.CONFIRMATION_OPEN: not authorized by v2; requires immutable validation decision and a new explicit release receipt
split_and_access.PANTHEON_OPEN: not authorized by v2 under any stage; requires its own covariance-aware executor, split, audit, and release

IDS_PARTITIONED.quantity: unique raw IDs by hash role before any eligibility field opens

split_and_access.abort: any path, hash, byte-count, schema, record, grammar, duplicate, coordinate, mask, distance, finite-value, solver, RNG, or stage-specific count failure aborts without a score

scoring_and_roles.development: profile the frozen 161-point delta_H grid; choose ties by profile_solver; compute the one-sided T and the 10000-permutation plus-one p-value; report every primary and partial-mask ID
scoring_and_roles.development_freeze: before any validation opening, freeze the signed best delta_H, all nuisance/grid/parser choices, development row ledger, predictions, observed T, permutation statistics, p-value, failures, and a binary decision without changing this contract
scoring_and_roles.validation: delta_H is fixed to the signed development value and is not reoptimized; profile the same nine nuisance coefficients separately under fixed delta_H and zero; report Delta_logL=0.5*(chi2_profile_zero-chi2_profile_fixed), its sign, per-object residuals, and all failures
scoring_and_roles.confirmation: if separately authorized after the validation decision freeze, apply the identical fixed development delta_H and validation formula without reoptimization
scoring_and_roles.no_pooling: development, validation, and confirmation rows are never pooled to estimate delta_H or nuisance coefficients
scoring_and_roles.no_threshold_invention: this correlation screen reports the frozen continuous statistics; it makes no mechanism or publication claim and may not add a post-response discovery threshold

geometry_join.maximal_filter: VAST_TABLE1 Cosmo equals exact ASCII 'Planck2018' and edge integer equals 0
geometry_join.sphere_join: associate Planck2018 VAST_TABLE2 on exact (Cosmo,void) to the unique Planck2018 VAST_TABLE1 map; reject absent IDs, exclude and count edge=1 matches, retain edge=0 matches
geometry_join.union: law-v4 analytic ray-sphere intervals clipped to [0,D_path] and unioned, never summed
geometry_join.units: divide VAST h^-1 Mpc values by h=0.674 exactly once before law evaluation; D_path is geometry-v3 Planck2018 comoving Mpc from CF4 Dist luminosity Mpc only
geometry_join.coordinate_probe: all Planck2018 VAST_TABLE1 rows reproduce x,y,z from RAdeg,DEdeg,s within the frozen geometry-v2 tolerance before any CF4 response opens
geometry_join.full_mask_primary: mask pixel true, 0<=h*D_path<=332.3856506347656, and L_unobserved<=1e-10 Mpc
geometry_join.partial_mask: retain ID and reason as counterevidence; do not score

excluded_and_remaining.HR4_64_MOCKS: not present in the official public release; no mock/RSD calibration or mechanism claim
excluded_and_remaining.PANTHEON_PLUS: hash-bound but sealed for a separate covariance-aware replication
excluded_and_remaining.claim: a future development opening can establish correlation only; it cannot establish a time-well mechanism, gravity modification, novelty, or publication readiness
